etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 比 'compare' (phonetic ヒ) — the hand weighing one against another: to critique, appraise.
mnemonic: Hold both up side by side and say which fails — ヒ. 批判: comparison with consequences.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 复 (phonetic フク) — the body's round middle: belly; the seat of temper and resolve in Japanese idiom.
mnemonic: Where dinner returns (复) three times a day — はら. 腹が立つ: the belly standing up angry.

etymology: Compound ideograph: two 立 'standing' figures side by side — abreast: to line up; ordinary as the middle of a row: regular.
mnemonic: Shoulder to shoulder in the queue — ならぶ. 並: also the menu's 'regular size', the row nobody photographs.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the gate (門) with its bar wedged in place — shut: to close.
mnemonic: The plank jammed across the doors — しめる. 閉店: the plank goes in at eight.

etymology: Pictograph: the right half of a split tree trunk (木 cut down the middle) — one side only: a piece, a fragment.
mnemonic: Half a log, forever missing its twin — かた. 片手: one hand; 片付ける: putting the halves away.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — cloth patched where it wore thin: to mend, supplement.
mnemonic: Sew the missing square back in — おぎなう. 補習: patching the syllabus; 候補: patch material on standby.

etymology: Compound: the sun sinking into the grasses (莫) with another 日 added when 莫 was borrowed away — day's end: dusk; days strung together: to live, livelihood.
mnemonic: Sun down in the weeds, another day of living spent — くれる, くらす. 暮らし: the sum of your sunsets.

etymology: Compound ideograph (simplified from 寶): jade (玉) kept under the roof (宀) — the household's treasure.
mnemonic: The gem the house was built around — たから. 宝物: what you'd carry out of the fire first.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 方 (phonetic ホウ) — going somewhere to speak with someone: to visit, inquire.
mnemonic: Words with a destination — おとずれる, たずねる. 訪問: the doorbell kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: a person hidden from sight — gone: to perish, be lost; the late.
mnemonic: Stepped behind the fold in the world — ない, ボウ. 亡くなる: the softest verb Japanese owns.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 亡 'gone' (phonetic ボウ) + heart (心) — vanished from the heart: to forget.
mnemonic: The heart's file marked 亡 — わすれる. 忘れ物: what your heart misplaced on the train.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 奉 (phonetic ボウ) — a straight length of wood: rod, pole.
mnemonic: Wood reduced to its simplest job — ボウ. 泥棒: the thief with the classic stick-over-shoulder.

etymology: Compound: wood (木) split by the hand (攵) into thin boards — flat pieces: the counter for sheets.
mnemonic: Planks shaved thin enough to count — マイ. 一枚, 二枚: paper, tickets, pizza — anything flat obeys.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 憂 (phonetic ユウ) — a person of refined feeling: gentle; refined above others: excellent; an actor.
mnemonic: Grace under everything — やさしい, すぐれる. 優しい人 and 優勝: tenderness and first place, same kanji.

etymology: Compound: relay posts strung out (垂) between towns (阝) — the courier stations: mail.
mnemonic: Town to town along the hanging line of post-stations — ユウ. 郵便局: the station that survived.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 予 (phonetic ヨ) + head (頁) — handed over ahead of need: to deposit, entrust.
mnemonic: Give it now, reclaim it later — あずける. 預金: your money, boarding at the bank.

etymology: Compound ideograph: strength (力) still thread-thin (幺) — small and weak: infant, very young.
mnemonic: Muscle like sewing thread — おさない. 幼稚園: where the threads tangle happily.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 谷 'valley' (phonetic ヨク) + 欠 'gaping' — an emptiness that gapes like a valley: desire, want.
mnemonic: A hunger with a canyon's acoustics — ほしい. 欲しい: the valley asking politely.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wings (羽) + 立 (phonetic ヨク) — the day standing ready on the wing: the next, the following.
mnemonic: Tomorrow already perched and flexing — ヨク. 翌日: the day that takes off at midnight.

etymology: Simplified from 亂: hands trying to untangle a snarled skein — chaos: disorder, riot.
mnemonic: A tongue wagging on a loose hinge — みだれる. 乱れる: hair, ranks, hearts — anything that had order.

etymology: Pictograph: paired egg-sacs with the yolk-dots inside — eggs, roe.
mnemonic: Two eggs drawn mid-cluster, dots for yolks — たまご. 卵かけご飯: the pictograph, cracked over rice.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 里 (phonetic リ) tucked inside the split garment (衣) — the lining side: the back, the hidden side.
mnemonic: The village sewn into the coat's lining — うら. 裏口: the door on the lining side of the house.

etymology: Compound: the road (彳) ruled out by the brush (聿) — the written measure all steps must keep: law, meter, rhythm.
mnemonic: Rules written in bar lines — リツ. 法律 for citizens, リズム for drummers: same grid.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 侖 'well-ordered' (phonetic ロン) — words stacked in order: reasoned argument, discourse.
mnemonic: Claims shelved in strict sequence — ロン. 論文: the shelf, footnoted; 議論: two shelves colliding.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 衣 'clothes' (phonetic イ) — leaning on what wraps you: to depend on.
mnemonic: Wrapped in someone else's coat — イ. 依頼: asking to borrow their sleeve too.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 韋 (phonetic イ) — a person of uncommon stature: great, admirable.
mnemonic: Standing a size larger than the crowd — えらい. 偉い!: the pat on the head, and the statues later.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 韋 'feet circling opposite ways' (phonetic イ) — paths that miss each other: to differ, be wrong.
mnemonic: Two patrols circling the wall in opposite directions, never meeting — ちがう. 違います: politely, 'our paths differ'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 兌 (phonetic エイ) — metal ground to a point: sharp, keen.
mnemonic: The blade's edge and the mind's — するどい. 鋭い質問: the question that draws blood.

etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 戉 (phonetic エツ) — running past the barrier: to cross, exceed.
mnemonic: Vault the checkpoint at a sprint — こえる. 引っ越し: crossing over with all your boxes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 垔 (phonetic エン) — what fire sends up: smoke.
mnemonic: Fire's signature, drifting west over the dirt — けむり. 禁煙: the signature forbidden indoors.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic — water gone stagnant and foul: dirty, to stain.
mnemonic: The puddle nobody steps in twice — きたない. 汚れる: the white shirt's destiny.

etymology: Compound: the grain stored deepest under the roof — the innermost recess: the interior, the far back.
mnemonic: Past every sliding door, the last room — おく. 奥さん: the one who governs it, by old convention.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 甲 (phonetic オウ) — the hand bearing down: to push, press, stamp.
mnemonic: Palm flat on the shell, weight in — おす. Doors again: 押 push, 引 pull — the daily pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 区 (phonetic オウ) + 欠 — chosen purely for sound to transcribe 'Europe' (欧羅巴): the West across Eurasia.
mnemonic: The district (区) that left everyone open-mouthed (欠) with its cathedrals — オウ. 欧米: Europe-and-America in one breath.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 果 'fruit' (phonetic カ) — sweets made where fruit left off: confectionery.
mnemonic: Fruit, perfected by a pastry chef — カ. お菓子: the orchard's decadent grandchildren.

etymology: Pictograph: a person between two dividing lines — wedged between parties: to mediate; armor pressed on the body; shellfish in shells.
mnemonic: Squeezed exactly in the middle — カイ. 紹介: wedging two strangers into acquaintance.

etymology: Compound: people lined up (比) speaking as one (白, here 'declare') — the whole company: all, everybody.
mnemonic: The line-up answers in unison — みんな. 皆さん: the polite roll call.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 交 (phonetic カク) — chariots matched shaft to shaft: to compare.
mnemonic: Two carts drag-raced to settle it — カク. 比較: the formal word for lining them up.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sunrise over the banner (龺) + a phonetic — moisture drawn off by the climbing sun: to dry.
mnemonic: Sun up, laundry out, puddles gone — かわく. 乾杯!: draining the glass dry, cheerfully.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 奐 (phonetic カン) — one thing handed out for another: to exchange, convert.
mnemonic: Old one out, new one in, same hand — かえる. 乗り換え: doing it with entire trains.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 干 (phonetic カン) — the body's water on its way to drying: sweat.
mnemonic: Water queued at the skin's drying rack — あせ. 汗をかく: summer's subscription service.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 瞏 (phonetic カン) — the jade ring with no start or end: a circle, a surrounding.
mnemonic: The ring that comes all the way around you — カン. 環境: the ring you live inside.

etymology: Pictograph: a mouth with something held on the tongue — savoring: sweet; going easy: indulgent.
mnemonic: Tongue pinning the candy in place — あまい. 甘える: sweetness as a strategy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 今 (phonetic ガン) + mouth (口) — held in the mouth unswallowed: to contain, include.
mnemonic: In the mouth, not yet down the hatch: included but pending — ふくむ. 税込み cousins: the price 含む everything.

etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 斤 (phonetic キ) — asking at the altar: to pray, to wish.
mnemonic: At the shrine, palms together, one precise request — いのる. 祈り: the axe-sharp kind of hoping.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 契 (phonetic キツ) — taking in by mouth: to eat, drink, smoke.
mnemonic: The mouth signs the contract — キツ. 喫茶店: consumption with saucers; 喫煙: with regrets.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 吉 (phonetic キツ) — pressed until nothing more fits: to stuff, cram; to press with questions.
mnemonic: Packed to the click of the lid — つめる. 缶詰: the tin; 詰め込み勉強: the student version.
